metasystem test groups · run named contract groups and their prerequisites for the proof command,
  without recording proof

  usage   metasystem test groups ID... [--environment] [--repo PATH]
          metasystem test groups --environment [--repo PATH]

Options
  --repo PATH     the repository, or any directory or file inside it (default: the current
                  directory) (also --root)
  --environment   with no ids, print only the landing environment

Examples
  metasystem test groups fast-static-build
  metasystem test groups --environment
